# 0.4.0 release plan: Paper Draft Analysis

Status: release candidate for [Analysis #32](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research-analysis/issues/32) and [#14](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research-analysis/issues/14) in the coordinated [Study to Evidence to Paper Draft release](https://github.com/cmudrc/design-research/issues/41). This file does not declare 0.4.0 released or published.

## Candidate notes

- Adds versioned structured analysis-result records with explicit inputs, hypotheses, assumptions, statistics, inclusions, exclusions, tables, figures, and completion status.
- Adds public contribution adapters for regression, comparisons, reliability, sequence/Markov, and dataset-summary result families.
- Adds deterministic ``study-paper-draft.zip`` creation and verification with safe paths, sanitized environment metadata, selected supporting data, and complete SHA-256 inventory coverage.
- Keeps bundle verification inspect-only and makes no automatic replay or environment-recreation claim.

## Outcome

Executed analyses produce structured, evidence-linked Methods and Results contributions, and selected study evidence can be packaged in a modest verified paper-draft bundle.

## Analysis-record scope

- Add a result writer, provisionally `write_analysis_result(...)`, recording method/parameters, input hashes, included runs, exclusions, completion status, outputs, and hypothesis links.
- Add a contribution adapter, provisionally `collect_analysis_paper_contributions(...)`, for factual Methods/Results material, tables, figures, test statistics, effect sizes, uncertainty, and reporting requirements.
- Extend existing provenance primitives such as `capture_run_context`, `write_run_manifest`, and `attach_provenance`.
- Treat planned-but-unexecuted analysis as a reporting gap, never a result.

## Bundle scope

- Package canonical artifacts, terminal run records, selected analysis inputs/outputs, paper draft, environment/package information, and integrity hashes as `study-paper-draft.zip`.
- Exclude secrets.
- Require an explicit decision before including sensitive participant data.
- Verify the bundle index and content hashes after creation.

## Acceptance

- Analysis contributions trace to completed records and retained inputs.
- Inclusion and exclusion accounting is explicit.
- Tables and figures resolve from portable paths.
- Bundle verification detects changed or missing inputs.
- Existing analysis and provenance APIs remain compatible.

## Non-goals

No paper assembler, automatic scientific interpretation, arbitrary code replay, environment recreation, live-model reproduction, storage service, or experiment-tracking platform.
